# job-agent-kit

> An AI agent workflow kit for Claude Code and Codex that scouts, screens, tracks and drafts for your job search, with your approval for outward actions.

MIT-licensed, version 0.2.0. Python 3.9+ powers the offline tracker. Personal files are local and git-ignored. No auto-apply bots are included. Exact targets and text require approval unless the user has pre-approved the action type. Platform terms still apply. The optional full-access worker is not a technical sandbox.

## Start here
- [English README](https://github.com/LeiZiKang/job-agent-kit/blob/main/README.md): Quick start, requirements, safety and qualified real-use figures.
- [Chinese README](https://github.com/LeiZiKang/job-agent-kit/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): Simplified Chinese introduction and setup.
- [Agent operating manual](https://github.com/LeiZiKang/job-agent-kit/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Red lines, tracker commands and weekly review.

- [Platform lessons](https://github.com/LeiZiKang/job-agent-kit/blob/main/docs/lessons.md): Observations from real use, not platform guarantees.
- [Strategy patterns](https://github.com/LeiZiKang/job-agent-kit/blob/main/docs/strategy-patterns.md): Optional hypotheses to review against the user's own outcomes.
